purpose: Records the resolution of every BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR finding raised by the three adversarial reviewers (GATE 10). Reviewer JSONs are immutable records of what was found at review time; this file records what was done. NITs are recorded when acted upon; accepted-as-is NITs say so.

resolutions.finding: docs/phase5/SOURCE_CHANGE_JUSTIFICATION.md Fix 5 still said 'three' MIT headers with status PENDING, contradicting the Phase-5.1 claim that every current doc was corrected to FOUR.
resolutions.resolution: RESOLVED: Fix 5 rewritten — corrected scope to FOUR files (3 kernel headers + test/hiprtc_selfcontained.cpp), documented the Phase-5-time PENDING state as history, and recorded the Phase-5.1 resolution (CONFIRMED right-to-contribute, 4/4 placeholders replaced, targeted revalidation executed on P5.1-CANDIDATE-R1).
resolutions.evidence: git diff of docs/phase5/SOURCE_CHANGE_JUSTIFICATION.md on this branch (committed in the Phase-5.1 evidence commit).

resolutions.finding: docs/phase5/PR_DRAFT_FINAL.md still pointed at the superseded P5 series/patch-dir/evidence paths without supersession annotation.
resolutions.resolution: RESOLVED: prominent SUPERSEDED SERIES POINTERS banner added at the top naming P5.1-CANDIDATE-R1 (commits, patch dir, manifest) and instructing regeneration before any submission.
resolutions.evidence: head of docs/phase5/PR_DRAFT_FINAL.md on this branch.

resolutions.finding: .gitattributes byte-exactness rules covered evidence/raw and evidence/phase2 but not patches/**; CRLF smudge on future checkout could break the recorded patch SHA256 chain.
resolutions.resolution: RESOLVED: 'patches/** -text' rule appended to .gitattributes (with comment). The committed blobs are LF; the rule guarantees checkout never converts them.

resolutions.finding: format-patch --stdout reproduction differs from series concat by two extra LF bytes; per-file output is byte-identical.
resolutions.resolution: RESOLVED (documented): per-file regeneration mandated in patches/phase5_1/canonical/README.md and in the Linux handoff apply instructions.

resolutions.finding: patches/phase5_1/canonical/ lacked the README.md present in earlier canonical dirs.
resolutions.resolution: RESOLVED: README.md written with patch table, series hash, LF/byte-exactness rules, apply order, expected reconstructed tree hash, DCO-pending note.

resolutions.finding: Phase-5.1 artifacts untracked at review time.
resolutions.resolution: RESOLVED by construction: all Phase-5.1 artifacts are committed to phase5.1/windows-final-candidate-freeze in the evidence commit that carries this file.

resolutions.finding: Handoff required Info2-level log-evidence lines but never pinned MIOPEN_LOG_LEVEL; a default release build would omit the mandated dispatch evidence.
resolutions.resolution: RESOLVED: handoff item 3 now requires MIOPEN_LOG_LEVEL=6 with the rationale (release builds default to Warning).

resolutions.finding: Handoff did not require harness binary identity across the A/B runs.
resolutions.resolution: RESOLVED: handoff now requires the SAME harness binary on both sides with recorded SHA256; the only variable between runs is the preloaded library.

resolutions.finding: ctest regex not anchored in handoff text.
windows_validation_status key 'yolo_train_amp_default: PASS' is skim-able as AMP-enabled success.
resolutions.resolution: RESOLVED (disclosure): the manifest carries yolo_amp_note stating amp_default passed as TRAINING with the AMP check failing in the current environment (FP32 fallback), the control experiment attributing it to environment (P5 DLL + wheel fail identically), and amp_genuine=false recorded honestly. Accepted residual: the boolean key name itself is kept for schema stability.

resolutions.finding: Small internal inconsistencies in CI evidence capture.
resolutions.resolution: ACCEPTED AS-IS: NIT-level capture inconsistencies in evidence JSONs that do not affect any verdict; raw logs retained.

resolutions.finding: Phase-5.1 corrections existed only as uncommitted working-tree changes at review time (incl. commit_subjects reorder visible only in diff).
resolutions.resolution: RESOLVED by construction: committed to the evidence branch in this commit; the diff itself is the disclosure.

resolutions.finding: Copyright holder identified by GitHub handle 'AIwork4me' rather than a legal name.
resolutions.resolution: ACCEPTED AS-IS: matches the user's exact authorization wording; the user may substitute a legal name at submission time.

resolutions.finding: Sign-off email uses the legacy bare-username noreply form.
resolutions.resolution: ACCEPTED AS-IS: verified linked to the account (Phase-5 audit §2); evidence chain unaffected. GitHub's modern numeric-ID form is an optional substitution for the user.

summary.note: All BLOCKER and MAJOR findings resolved before the freeze was published (mission GATE 10 requirement).
